findings.title: Attack 8 (P2): the answers of M8's two predictions (b1 and b5) are stated only in their reveals
findings.location: site/src/content/modules/m8-lie-algebras.mdx:65 (b1 prediction) and :99 (b5 prediction). No later sentence of beats 1 to 5, no caption and nothing in the Seen box states either answer.
findings.claim: M8's two predictions are answered only by the reveal, and without JavaScript only inside the closed <details>. b1: after firing node 1 then node 2 from (2,0) the position is (0,-2), whose string at node 1 is that position alone. b5: the orbit of node 3 of D4 has 8 positions, as many as node 1. The prose never states either result, before or after the question.
findings.expected: SPEC 8.1 P2: 'Results are stated in the prose. Tooltips repeat information; they never hold it alone.' SPEC 4.0 Starts meaningful: 'Nothing the argument needs is available only after a click.' RT-13 attack 8: 'The answer to a prediction must also appear in the prose after the prediction block (P2: the reveal repeats, it never holds the result alone)'. Oracle (redteam/rt13-p5-oracle-m8.py): b1 gives (0,-2) and 1 position; b5 gives orbit size 8 (D4 orbit sizes 8, 24, 8, 8).
findings.observed: redteam/rt13-p5-reveal-only.mjs on the release reading log, with and without JavaScript: b1 'stated outside the reveal in: nowhere'; b5 'nowhere'. Without JavaScript both answers sit in a closed <details> ('1' and '8'). The modules before M8 state their answers in prose or captions; M8's author avoided printing them because of P3-RT-13-01.
